capabilities: list template files in the settings pane
enable template files to create commands
insert a template via a user-assigned hotkey
work with templates from the core Templates plugin and Templater
disambiguation: It does not provide its own hotkey system; it only adds commands that are assigned via Obsidian's built-in Hotkeys settings.
extras: Author accepts Ko-fi donations; plugin requires Obsidian v0.9.7+.
problem: Obsidian's Templates core plugin and Templater offer no built-in way to bind a specific template to its own hotkey.

relations.evidence: Templates from the core templates plugin

requires.name: core Templates plugin (template folder must be set)

summary: Hotkey plugin that adds one insert command per enabled template file, assignable through Obsidian's hotkey settings.
